summary: Package github.com/hoangvu12/gpui-go/base: Init/IsMobile, Theme + ThemeGlobal/ThemeGlobalMut, semantic theme tokens (shadcn names: primary, muted, border, ring, ...), scrollbar value types, StyledExt (HFlex/VFlex/RefineStyle/Paddings/Margins/Font*/CornerRadii/Debug*), StateStyle, ElementExt.OnPrepaint, InteractiveElementExt (LockScrollAxis/OnDoubleClick), observe, measure, component traits (Selectable/Disableable/FocusableExt/CollapsibleTrait), ui actions, geometry (Placement/Side/Edges), IndexPath, ListSettings, GlobalState, reduce_motion (SystemParametersInfoW SPI_GETCLIENTAREAANIMATION via syscall), Root + RootPlugin stages, History[T], UndoHistory[T].
pinned_sources: reference/ce-source/crates/gpui/src/style.rs:1024-1027 (Style::default display Flex at the core pin)
package_layout: one base package mirroring the crate (base/*.go); dependency-free data structures in subpackages under base/ (ticket 15). Naming: T::f -> TF, new -> NewT, Default -> DefaultT, extension traits -> wrappers (StyledExtOf(gpui.Div()).HFlex()). Recorded in base/doc.go.

tests.upstream_ported_detail: unchanged 42 (history 10, undo_history 14, theme 1, theme_tokens 1, state_style 4, component_traits 2, actions 1, index_path 3, reduce_motion 5, root 1); adapted 4 (styled 1: col-stretch width, see deviations; global_state 2: drop(token) -> Release(); observe 1: normal-build branch only)
not_applicable: async_util.rs (channel re-export replaced by Go chan; 0 tests)
test_support.rs (only consumer is Kit, out of scope; see deviations)

orchestrator_rerun.where: git checkout-index snapshot of the committed tree + staged base/ (ticket 10/15 in-progress files excluded)

deviations: Retargeting fact (map gap 2b): Base builds against crates.io gpui-ce 0.2.2 whose Style::default is display Block (beb5a6d crates/gpui/src/style.rs:971); the core pin defaults to Flex (style.rs:1024-1027). The styled cross-axis test's col-stretch assertion (styled.rs:283, 200px) becomes 'fills the column's own width' (100px under the default flex row).
test_support.rs not ported: Kit-only consumer; a Go Observed wrapper would push the element id twice and cannot reach the div hitbox.
Theme has no plot field yet (PlotMotion needs motion Spring/Transition): ticket 14/31.
Root: no ctrl-c Copy binding (tickets 20/29), no TextSelectionLayer child (29); activeFocusTrap is a placeholder reporting no trap (16 replaces it); plugin entities owned by the window scope.
Init covers this ticket's modules only; later modules add their init calls with their tickets.
reduce_motion treats App.Host()==nil as the test scheduler (real apps call Init after Attach); a gpui App.IsTestScheduler() would replace the guess.
debug_* helpers always apply (no debug/release split); JSON uses the core's Go color/pixel shapes; schemars/FluentBuilder on scrollbar styles dropped; OngoingScrollLockAxis takes app.
Scrollbar value types live in base/scrollbar_values.go; ticket 18 moves them into scrollbar.go.
follow_ups: gpui: App.IsTestScheduler() (or equivalent) to replace the Host()==nil guess
